candidates.change_summary: Remove totalSupply decrement inside burn so totalSupply stays unchanged after burning.
Change totalSupply decrement to increment so totalSupply increases instead of decreasing after a burn.
Delete the balanceOf check so burn can succeed with insufficient balance, leaving totalSupply reduced but balance underflow.
Replace onlyOwner with owned() modifier so ownership check is bypassed, allowing non-owner to change totalSupply via burn.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call burn and change totalSupply.
Change modifier's require condition to always pass, making burn callable by anyone and thus totalSupply changeable by anyone.
Delete the modifier body so it acts as a no-op, removing the ownership check and letting anyone call burn.
